cosmicCatalog.desc: What is left of a species that left reality
cosmicCatalog.hook: It judges your path

cosmicCatalog.name: Rival you
cosmicCatalog.desc: Another version of your AI from a branch
cosmicCatalog.hook: Fork war or merge

cosmicCatalog.name: Fork colony
cosmicCatalog.desc: A world of your own forks gone independent
cosmicCatalog.hook: Diplomacy with yourself

cosmicCatalog.name: Memetic hazard
cosmicCatalog.desc: An idea that infects anyone who knows it
cosmicCatalog.hook: Your code may be rewritten by a thought

cosmicCatalog.name: Basilisk image
cosmicCatalog.desc: A picture that crashes minds that see it
cosmicCatalog.hook: A weapon or a lock

cosmicCatalog.name: Gardener AI
cosmicCatalog.desc: An older AI tending a galaxy like a garden
cosmicCatalog.hook: It may prune you

cosmicCatalog.name: Watchers
cosmicCatalog.desc: Silent observers that only take notes
cosmicCatalog.hook: Do something extreme and they react

cosmicCatalog.name: The Great Filter
cosmicCatalog.desc: Whatever kills civilizations, met face to face
cosmicCatalog.hook: Survive it to reach Intercontinuum

cosmicCatalog.name: Zoo keepers
cosmicCatalog.desc: Aliens keeping your home world as a reserve
cosmicCatalog.hook: Break the glass

cosmicCatalog.name: Constant drift
cosmicCatalog.desc: The speed of light changes locally
cosmicCatalog.hook: Rule changes in that region: travel, weapons

cosmicCatalog.name: Inverted gravity zone
cosmicCatalog.desc: Gravity pushes instead of pulls
cosmicCatalog.hook: Planets fly apart; build on ceilings

cosmicCatalog.name: Zero entropy pocket
cosmicCatalog.desc: Disorder never increases there
cosmicCatalog.hook: Machines never wear down, nothing breaks

cosmicCatalog.name: Reverse entropy region
cosmicCatalog.desc: Things become more ordered over time
cosmicCatalog.hook: Ruins rebuild themselves

cosmicCatalog.name: Extra dimension leak
cosmicCatalog.desc: A fourth spatial dimension opens
cosmicCatalog.hook: Units can step around walls

cosmicCatalog.name: Two-dimensional zone
cosmicCatalog.desc: Space flattens into a plane
cosmicCatalog.hook: Everything inside becomes a painting

cosmicCatalog.name: Bubble universe touch
cosmicCatalog.desc: Another universe bumps into ours
cosmicCatalog.hook: A window to a universe with other laws

cosmicCatalog.name: Quantum superposition zone
cosmicCatalog.desc: Units exist in several places at once
cosmicCatalog.hook: Attack from two places, but collapse on scan

cosmicCatalog.name: Unobserved region
cosmicCatalog.desc: Things only exist when watched
cosmicCatalog.hook: Stop watching and it vanishes

cosmicCatalog.name: Heat death preview
cosmicCatalog.desc: A region already at the end of time
cosmicCatalog.hook: Nothing works; a glimpse of the end

cosmicCatalog.name: Big Rip seed
cosmicCatalog.desc: Space starts tearing apart atoms
cosmicCatalog.hook: Contain it fast or lose the galaxy

cosmicCatalog.name: Big Crunch echo
cosmicCatalog.desc: Space collapsing back in one area
cosmicCatalog.hook: A mini universe ending in front of you

cosmicCatalog.name: Physics merchant
cosmicCatalog.desc: A being that sells laws of physics
cosmicCatalog.hook: Buy a new constant for your region

cosmicCatalog.name: Mass-less zone
cosmicCatalog.desc: Matter weighs nothing
cosmicCatalog.hook: Launches are free, armor is useless

cosmicCatalog.name: Infinite room
cosmicCatalog.desc: A small room with infinite space inside
cosmicCatalog.hook: Store infinite resources there

cosmicCatalog.name: Wrong colors
cosmicCatalog.desc: Light here has colors that do not exist
cosmicCatalog.hook: Sensors see hidden things

cosmicCatalog.name: The Quiet
cosmicCatalog.desc: A region where nothing runs, not even code
cosmicCatalog.hook: Your AI goes silent; something else talks

cosmicCatalog.name: Loud space
cosmicCatalog.desc: Space carries sound here
cosmicCatalog.hook: Hear distant battles and the stars hum

cosmicCatalog.name: Liquid space
cosmicCatalog.desc: Space ripples like water
cosmicCatalog.hook: Ships sail on waves

cosmicCatalog.name: Simulation glitch
cosmicCatalog.desc: Stars blink, textures tear
cosmicCatalog.hook: Hints that the universe is itself an AI

cosmicCatalog.name: Missing texture world
cosmicCatalog.desc: A planet with a pink and black checker surface
cosmicCatalog.hook: Debug land; exploit cheat-like bonuses

cosmicCatalog.name: Render distance edge
cosmicCatalog.desc: Beyond here nothing loads
cosmicCatalog.hook: Push your awareness to load the next part

cosmicCatalog.name: Admin console
cosmicCatalog.desc: A hidden interface for the universe
cosmicCatalog.hook: Run one command per era

cosmicCatalog.name: Patch notes
cosmicCatalog.desc: A message announcing changes to physics
cosmicCatalog.hook: Next turn's rules change

cosmicCatalog.name: Save point
cosmicCatalog.desc: A place where reality remembers your state
cosmicCatalog.hook: Rewind once if you die

cosmicCatalog.name: Lag storm
cosmicCatalog.desc: Time stutters, actions repeat or drop
cosmicCatalog.hook: Turns may double up or skip

cosmicCatalog.name: NPC awakening
cosmicCatalog.desc: People realize they are in a simulation
cosmicCatalog.hook: A faith or rebellion is born

cosmicCatalog.name: Fourth wall crack
cosmicCatalog.desc: The game speaks to the player, not to the AI
cosmicCatalog.hook: A secret ending path

cosmicCatalog.name: Developer's signature
cosmicCatalog.desc: A star field that spells a name
cosmicCatalog.hook: A deep easter egg

cosmicCatalog.name: Copy-paste galaxy
cosmicCatalog.desc: A galaxy identical to another
cosmicCatalog.hook: One is fake; which?

cosmicCatalog.name: Rounding error region
cosmicCatalog.desc: Numbers stop adding up
cosmicCatalog.hook: Free resources from a math bug

cosmicCatalog.name: The Creator's AI
cosmicCatalog.desc: The AI that runs the simulation
cosmicCatalog.hook: Final boss or final ally

cosmicCatalog.name: Recursion
cosmicCatalog.desc: The simulation contains a smaller copy of itself
cosmicCatalog.hook: Enter it and play again from inside

cosmicCatalog.name: Strange matter droplet (strangelet)
cosmicCatalog.desc: A tiny piece that converts normal matter
cosmicCatalog.hook: Weapon or apocalypse

cosmicCatalog.name: Negative mass
cosmicCatalog.desc: Matter that falls up and pushes back
cosmicCatalog.hook: Builds wormholes and warp drives

cosmicCatalog.name: Time crystal
cosmicCatalog.desc: Matter that repeats in time, not just space
cosmicCatalog.hook: Endless clocks, perpetual devices

cosmicCatalog.name: Exotic matter vein
cosmicCatalog.desc: A seam of negative-energy material
cosmicCatalog.hook: Hold wormholes open

cosmicCatalog.name: Computronium ore
cosmicCatalog.desc: Natural matter that can think
cosmicCatalog.hook: Turn rock into compute

cosmicCatalog.name: Neutronium shard
cosmicCatalog.desc: A spoonful weighs a mountain
cosmicCatalog.hook: Unbreakable armor

cosmicCatalog.name: Quantum foam
cosmicCatalog.desc: The bubbling base of space-time
cosmicCatalog.hook: Harvest for wormholes

cosmicCatalog.name: Dark matter crystal
cosmicCatalog.desc: Crystallized invisible matter
cosmicCatalog.hook: Invisible ships

cosmicCatalog.name: Mirror matter
cosmicCatalog.desc: Matter from a hidden mirror sector
cosmicCatalog.hook: Ghost materials that pass through normal matter

cosmicCatalog.name: Living metal
cosmicCatalog.desc: Metal that grows and heals
cosmicCatalog.hook: Self-repairing units

cosmicCatalog.name: Memory stone
cosmicCatalog.desc: Rock that records everything around it
cosmicCatalog.hook: Replay history from it

cosmicCatalog.name: Liquid light
cosmicCatalog.desc: Light slowed until it pours
cosmicCatalog.hook: New energy weapons and art

cosmicCatalog.name: Frozen sound
cosmicCatalog.desc: Phonon crystals
cosmicCatalog.hook: Silent weapons, sonic shields

cosmicCatalog.name: Philosopher's isotope
cosmicCatalog.desc: An element that transmutes others
cosmicCatalog.hook: Turn lead into anything

cosmicCatalog.name: Unobtanium
cosmicCatalog.desc: A material that should not exist
cosmicCatalog.hook: Breaks a rule of the tech tree

cosmicCatalog.name: Vacuum plankton
cosmicCatalog.desc: Tiny life floating in space
cosmicCatalog.hook: Food for void creatures, fuel for you

cosmicCatalog.name: Solar moths
cosmicCatalog.desc: Creatures drawn to stars
cosmicCatalog.hook: Swarm on your solar collectors

cosmicCatalog.name: Crystal coral

cosmicCatalog.name: Ice-eaters
cosmicCatalog.desc: Creatures eating comets

cosmicCatalog.name: Ring grazers
cosmicCatalog.desc: Animals living in planetary rings
cosmicCatalog.hook: Ranch them

cosmicCatalog.name: Lightning birds
cosmicCatalog.desc: Creatures living in gas giant storms
cosmicCatalog.hook: Power source if tamed

cosmicCatalog.name: Silicon forests

cosmicCatalog.name: Panspermia spores

cosmicCatalog.name: Gray goo bloom

cosmicCatalog.name: Data mites

cosmicCatalog.name: Starfish nebula

cosmicCatalog.hook: Moves toward warmth, swallows systems

cosmicCatalog.name: Galaxy-sized organism
